description: This file contains controller functions for managing OpenAI Assistant Vector Store operations, including CRUD operations and file uploads/deletions, in an Express.js application.

methods.name: getAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Handles retrieving a specific assistant vector store by ID, validating request parameters, and calling the service layer.

methods.name: listAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Handles listing all assistant vector stores for a given credential.

methods.name: createAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Handles creating a new assistant vector store with provided data and credential.

methods.name: updateAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Handles updating an existing assistant vector store identified by ID, with validation.

methods.name: deleteAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Handles deleting an assistant vector store by ID, with credential validation.

methods.name: uploadFilesToAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Handles uploading files to a specific assistant vector store, including file validation.

methods.name: deleteFilesFromAssistantVectorStore
methods.description: Handles deleting files from a specific assistant vector store by file IDs.
